trace.title: Durable notification intent
trace.detail: An email integration has several states: saved intent, attempted request, provider acceptance, recipient-server delivery, bounce, suppression, and user interaction. The API accepting a request does not prove the person received or read it.

trace.title: Follow one item
trace.detail:
Follow one notification ID through retries and provider events. A webhook can be repeated or arrive after another event. Define allowed state transitions from observed facts rather than assuming arrival order is perfect.

For a timeout, check provider-supported status/idempotency behavior before resending. If acceptance is unknown, record uncertainty and reconcile rather than asserting success or failure without evidence.

trace.title: Try the failure
trace.detail: A delivered event does not prove the human read the message. Tracking opens can have privacy/client artifacts. Webhook bodies alone are not proof of sender authenticity.
